facts.label: Who issues the policy?
facts.text: Ladder Insurance Services is an agency. Its current disclosure names Amica Life, Fidelity Security Life and S.USA Life as issuing insurers, with different state availability. The issuing insurer is responsible for its policy.

facts.label: Medical requirements
facts.text: Ladder advertises no medical exams for applications of $3 million or less, with health questions still required. Above that amount, a health check may be requested. This is not guaranteed acceptance.

facts.label: Changing coverage
facts.text: You can reduce coverage and premiums on eligible products. To increase coverage, you apply for an additional policy; underwriting and approval still apply. Laddering availability varies by product.
